test_title: PYST 25: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0660927a2b4554808f007cc1e81cbf6d13e93a0c4c1d0006751737f23609510e.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -2, +7.

Let's check each option:

1. LG-JN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cf55866fb5edbb7ac28eebb632eca2049f711e8ecb809cd63935c094b4f167a.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -2, +7.

2. ID -GL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/346ab8f9d5bb6d6a76c973c1121762051a7778f752bc7c5f9c1b6560bc048291.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -2, +7.

3. RM-PT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ce3848feb6a807bdcc542faa7473d86ce796b11426d0912438358854a1bb31.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -2, +7.

4. OJ-MQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f2ca7b1c2c0ee70876c8544fc37f94e4450ba03b0b0c6146d85e368558e94f9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -2, +7.

Thus, ID-GL is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
